answer: Give every agent an ivory credential that silently expires after a random 5 to 15 epochs. Renewal means re-locking a bond and passing a fresh live task generated for that key alone, and a lapsed identity drops to zero vote weight. An honest agent handles this once per cycle, but a farm of 200 clones faces an endless ridge of renewals at unpredictable moments; each pearl of earned reputation evaporates the epoch its upkeep is missed, so mass sybils never become a one-time cost.
